environment: synthetic localhost provider; real Node HTTP/SSE and Store; no external account or user vault

checks.name: unbound chat is rejected before any request
API keys live only in public secret storage and profiles expose only saved-key state
Mini and Normal each stream vision/text; Normal streams a function and receives the matching tool result
a recreated service retains nonsecret binding without putting the key in profile storage
condensation uses the real bound transport once per missing tier and never sends tools
condensation sends only the selected image through the bound real transport
SSE reconstructs split UTF-8 Chinese/emoji and streams fragments before completion
only explicitly supplied context/images are sent and Mini uses the configured Mini model
streamed card tools return editable previews and round-trip preview results without writing or enrolling
user-edited card preview saves through real Store as one undoable change and persists across reload
AI outline streams a hierarchical proposal and explicit save creates real parent/child nodes
invalid outline levels and a mid-batch Store failure cannot leave partial content
image/text Markdown recognition produces an editable draft and saves only to a new explicit filename
endpoint/model/key changes invalidate binding, while an unchanged saved key is retained
failed vision, streamed tools or tool-result checks each leave chat unavailable
in-flight profile edits cannot bind an obsolete configuration
local no-key services work and clearing a key does not serialize it into profile or Store backups
HTTP error bodies and redirects cannot expose a key or forward it to another endpoint
nonstreaming, malformed SSE and truncated content are rejected instead of reported complete
interleaved tool-call indices, names and argument fragments reconstruct in original index order
abort stops an in-flight stream and returns a stable cancellation error
unsupported tools never execute or write files, and repeated invalid calls stop at the round limit
profiles in separate vault-local stores use different secret identifiers
